research_question: Does increasing admissible organizational degree of freedom produce new continuation organizations while preserving the primitive law inside a bounded symbolic continuation model?
hypothesis: Increasing admissible organizational DoF expands the set of lawful continuation organizations, introduces structurally novel stable organization classes that cannot exist in lower-DoF domains, and leaves the primitive binding law unchanged. If no structurally novel classes appear after bounded projection analysis, additional organizational dimensions are representational only within this model.

independent_variables.name: organizational_dof
independent_variables.definition: Maximum number of distinct aspect positions that a single continuation-binding event may organize while the primitive binding rule remains unchanged.
independent_variables.allowed_values_or_range: 1..6 in the initial Colab sweep; DoF=1 primitive chain, DoF=2 paired organization, DoF=3 recursive triads, DoF>3 nested RT organizations under the same binder.

independent_variables.name: enumeration_depth_limit
independent_variables.definition: Bound on recursive organization depth used to keep the symbolic search recoverable in Colab.

dependent_variables.name: admissible_continuation_count
dependent_variables.definition: Number of lawful organizations reachable under the current DoF and bounded continuation rules.

dependent_variables.name: illegal_organization_count
dependent_variables.definition: Number of generated candidate organizations rejected by admissibility, closure, or primitive-preservation checks.

dependent_variables.name: closure_rate
dependent_variables.definition: Fraction of reachable lawful organizations classified as closed under the bounded closure definition.

dependent_variables.name: organization_entropy
dependent_variables.definition: Shannon entropy over structural organization-class frequencies at a fixed DoF.

dependent_variables.name: projection_diversity
dependent_variables.definition: Number of distinct lower-DoF projection signatures induced by the current lawful organization set.

dependent_variables.name: primitive_preservation_rate
dependent_variables.definition: Share of lawful organizations whose derivation witness uses only the single primitive binder and fixed continuation rules.

dependent_variables.name: new_stable_organization_count
dependent_variables.definition: Number of stable lawful organizations at the current DoF whose class is absent from all lower-DoF domains.

dependent_variables.name: organization_depth
dependent_variables.definition: Average and maximum recursive depth of lawful organizations in the current DoF domain.

dependent_variables.name: continuation_branching
dependent_variables.definition: Average one-step successor count in the bounded continuation graph.

dependent_variables.name: novel_organization_rate
dependent_variables.definition: Fraction of lawful organization classes at the current DoF that cannot be represented losslessly in any lower-DoF domain.

dependent_variables.name: symmetry_classification_counts
dependent_variables.definition: Counts of symmetric, asymmetric, and mixed lawful organizations at the current DoF.

controls.name: primitive_law_lock
controls.purpose: Hold the primitive law fixed while organizational richness varies.
controls.implementation: Use a single primitive binding function for every organization regardless of DoF; changing DoF only changes admissible slot count, not the binder semantics.

controls.name: rt_core_lock
controls.purpose: Prevent RT_core from drifting during the campaign.
controls.implementation: Keep RT_core assumptions, residue rules, arbitration policy, and continuation mechanics constant across all DoF sweeps.

controls.name: checkpointed_outputs
controls.implementation: Write per-DoF catalogs, metrics, and novelty tables immediately after each sweep stage.

controls.name: bounded_model_disclosure
controls.purpose: Prevent the symbolic operationalization from being mistaken for the calculus itself.
controls.implementation: Interpret outputs only as bounded evidence about the declared symbolic organizational model, not as theorem proof or external validation.

controls.name: novelty_requires_projection_test
controls.purpose: Avoid counting larger arity alone as novelty.
controls.implementation: A class counts as novel only if no lossless projection into any lower-DoF domain exists under the declared projection operator.

random_seed.seed_scope: Deterministic catalog ordering, example selection, and any bounded tie-breaking.
random_seed.derivation_policy: Fixed before execution; stochastic sampling is not the primary method.

parameter_space.name: organizational_dof_sweep
parameter_space.sampling_rule: Evaluate all declared DoF values in order.

parameter_space.name: max_depth
parameter_space.sampling_rule: Primary execution uses depth 4; reduced depths are available for crash recovery or debugging.

parameter_space.name: max_children_per_node
parameter_space.sampling_rule: Do not exceed the active DoF at any organization node.

parameter_space.name: projection_targets
parameter_space.values_or_range: all lower DoF values below the active DoF
parameter_space.sampling_rule: Every higher-DoF class must be tested against all lower-DoF targets for novelty classification.

termination_conditions: All declared DoF values are evaluated or emit a recoverable skip record.
Per-DoF metrics, lawful catalogs, novelty tables, and projection summaries are written.
Primitive preservation is reported for every DoF.
Novel organization rate is computed using explicit lower-DoF projection tests.
A follow-on plan for MPF_SIM_PROJECTION_INDUCTION_001 is written, but no second-campaign result claim is made in this notebook.

expected_outputs.name: lawful_organization_catalog
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Recoverable catalog of lawful organization classes and metrics by DoF.

expected_outputs.name: novel_organization_catalog
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Lists organization classes that have no lossless lower-DoF projection.

expected_outputs.name: projection_loss_table
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Prepares the follow-on induction campaign by quantifying loss and closure preservation under lower-DoF projection.

expected_outputs.name: output_manifest
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Binds source design, parameters, outputs, claim ceiling, and follow-on non-claims.

decision_rules: BOUNDED_SUPPORT_C2_CANDIDATE: higher DoF adds lawful classes with nonzero novel_organization_rate while primitive_preservation_rate remains 1.0 in the bounded model.
BOUNDED_NULL_C2_CANDIDATE: higher DoF changes representation counts but novel_organization_rate remains 0 across the bounded sweep.
MODEL_LIMITATION_C2: higher DoF expansion appears only because the symbolic operationalization changed in an uncontrolled way or primitive preservation fails.
FOLLOW_ON_REQUIRED: novelty is present but projection-loss structure requires the separate MPF_SIM_PROJECTION_INDUCTION_001 campaign before stronger interpretation.
allowed_interpretations: Bounded evidence about whether the declared symbolic organizational model produces structurally novel continuation classes under higher organizational DoF.
Bounded null evidence if higher DoF is representational only within the declared model.
Motivation for the separate projection-back campaign MPF_SIM_PROJECTION_INDUCTION_001.
blocked_interpretations: Proof that the calculus universally generates new ontology from higher DoF.
Promotion above C2 without approved-tool replication and governed result induction.
Treating the symbolic operationalization as identical to RT_core or the full calculus.

immutability.supersession_policy: Do not edit after execution starts; create a new spec_id and link the superseding specification.
